purpose: Example access overlay. Declares which model lanes exist, what each is allowed to do, which quota pool funds it, and how roles step down. Copy to ~/.config/orchestrator/access-overlay.json and edit for your accounts. NOTE: existing harness lanes are marked verified for illustration. The Pi lane is deliberately an unverified candidate until you verify native access and explicitly admit it. Set access_status honestly for your own accounts; an unverified lane is refused on purpose. Plans (`quota_pools.<pool>.plan`) leave prices and allowances unset: configure your own; an allowance is always an estimate and null when the provider does not publish one. Effort blocks are illustrative policy, not measured evidence: verify your CLI controls, choose levels, and replace evidence.source/read_on before dispatch. Model pins are watch-only until you opt into management.

antigravity-gemini.exhaustion_behaviour: HARD FAIL, not degradation: when the cap is hit Antigravity returns RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (429) with a reset timer, and does not fall back to a lighter model. So EXHAUSTED keeps blocking this pool; treating 100% as 'degraded but usable' would send calls straight into a 429.

example-model-key.note: Free-text evidence about how this model actually performed for you. Priors, never verdicts: replace with your own observations.

model_cards._about: Optional plain-language cards for the console's model switches. name, best_for (one line), speed (only when measured), run_as (the id a direct wrapper passes; default the key), aliases, pool (for models with no routing lane), status current|older, order, allowance, hidden. Older models default off without a comparative reason: older_model_reasons maps a pool to {job, advantage: cheaper|faster|better, compared_to: current model key, reason, evidence}. Sourced better_than_successor_at measurements also qualify against a current successor. A card never admits a routing lane.

routing.principle: hard gates first, then highest task-specific quality; step down only at CONSERVE; at UNKNOWN run one best lane without duplicate frontier retries
